## Overdue reminders
Daily: fetch overdue loans from Convex (signed GET), remind each borrower, write the result back (signed POST).
- Write-backs carry an idempotency key `overdue:<loanId>:<date>`, so HTTP retries and re-runs never create duplicates.
- HTTP nodes retry 3× (5 s apart); a run that still fails goes to the error workflow, which records it in Convex.
